note: Etkinlik, örüntü, İngilizce kelime ve Piko poz görselleri için Codex imagegen istekleri (docs/ART.md). Stil metni her isteğe aynen eklenir; Piko pozları ilk Piko oturumundan çatallanır. Görsellerde insan, el, vücut parçası, yazı ve rakam yoktur; para değerleri ve saat rakamları HTML/SVG ile basılır. Noktalama Atölyesi: mark-* karakterleri ve p/ soru resimleri.

items.name: tool/street
items.prompt: SCENE, NOT an isolated asset: ignore the magenta background rule for this image. Wide landscape 3:2 image. A cheerful clay diorama of a quiet neighbourhood street, seen from the front and slightly above (camera about 30 degrees down). A straight two-lane asphalt road in soft warm grey runs perfectly horizontally across the whole image from the left edge to the right edge, with a dashed cream centre line. A white zebra crosswalk crosses the road a little right of centre: six thick cream bars that run parallel to the road, stacked from the far sidewalk to the near sidewalk. Pale warm stone sidewalks line the far (upper) and near (lower) edges of the road; soft green grass beyond them; a few round clay bushes and two small round trees on the far side only. The street is completely empty: no vehicles, no people, no animals, no traffic lights, no poles, no signs, no text. The road and both sidewalks together fill the middle 70% of the image height. Soft warm daylight, gentle ambient occlusion.
items.note: Sahne; magenta yok. 1536×1024 çıktının y 120–888 bandı kırpılıp 1200×600 yazıldı.

items.name: mark-question
items.prompt: Mascot character for a punctuation lesson, matching the clay material and friendly face style of Piko in the reference image. Exception to the text rule for this image only: the character's whole body IS a chunky clay QUESTION MARK (?) shape, a symbol and not a letter; nothing else may contain text. The curved hook is its body and the separate round dot below it is its little ball-shaped foot. Powder-blue clay (#7fb3d8). A friendly face on the upper curve: dark dot eyes, peach cheeks, a small curious open smile, one eyebrow raised. Two tiny stubby clay arms; it holds a small wooden magnifying glass. Front view, centered, full figure visible.
items.note: Noktalama Atölyesi karakter ailesinin çapası; Piko referansıyla üretildi.

items.name: mark-dot
items.prompt: Character: a FULL STOP (period). Its whole body is one plump, perfectly round clay ball (a dot) in deep navy blue (#3f5f9a). Calm, content face with gently closed happy eyes and a tiny smile; its stubby arms are held up in front in a friendly "stop and rest" gesture; a tiny cream pillow rests beside it.

items.name: mark-exclaim
items.prompt: Character: an EXCLAMATION MARK (!). Its body is a tall chunky rounded vertical bar, a little wider at the top and narrower at the bottom, with a separate round ball-shaped dot below it as its foot. Coral red (#e8705c). Excited face on the upper part of the bar: wide open eyes and a big open smile; stubby arms thrown up in joy; three small butter-yellow sparkles around it.

items.name: mark-comma
items.prompt: Character: a COMMA (,). Its body is a round ball head with a short curved tail curving down and to the left underneath, like a small tadpole. Soft teal (#4fb0a3). Relaxed face with eyes closed, taking a slow calm breath; a small cream swirl of breeze near its mouth; stubby arms resting at its sides.

items.name: mark-apostrophe
items.prompt: Character: an APOSTROPHE. Its body looks like a small comma floating up high: a round head with a short curved tail curving down and to the left. Lavender purple (#a98fd6). Cheerful grin; it holds a pair of tiny rounded child-safe scissors with butter-yellow handles. Floating below it is a short cream clay ribbon neatly cut into two pieces with a small gap between them.
